Accountant Job at the Milk Booster




        
    

        
        The Milk Booster is Nigeria's foremost breastfeeding company for healthy lactation treats that increases breastmilk supply for nursing mothers. Our Company is committed to helping breastfeeding mothers overcome issues of low milk supply thereby building a healthy family.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Iyana Ejigbo, Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Prepare accurate and timely financial statements.
	Manage accounts payable and receivable.
	Monitor inventory records and reconcile stock.
	Analyze production costs and prepare financial reports.
	Develop budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses.
	Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal controls.
	Reconcile bank statements and general ledger accounts.
	Support internal and external audits.
	Improve financial processes and reporting systems.
	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	1–3 years of relevant accounting or finance experience.
	Professional certification is an added advantage.
	Proficiency in ERP systems, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Word.
	Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
	Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Salary Range
N150,000 - N200,000 / Month.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of email.
